banks.note: drawing - the front view labels six spans B1 to B6 with [DARK GRAY], [DARK GRAY], [LIGHT GRAY], [LIGHT GRAY], [WIHTE] and [WIHTE]. The drawing spells the last two WIHTE, and they are drawn white. A span is one C19 and half a moulding. The rear view labels the six breaker plates B1 to B6, each with its line legend. THAT SPAN Bk IS FED BY BREAKER Bk IS A READING OF THE LABELS. The three greys are drawn as #55585c, #9a9da1 and #e4e5e7 and are estimates of the words.

capability.note: datasheet - the drawing's unit type is BASIC and the 'Basic Power Distribution Units (PDUs)' sheet lists no metering or switching for the line. So `metering-scope: none` and `outlet-switching: false`.

chassis.note: drawing - 915.0 long and 112.0 deep (top view). The SIDE VIEW prints 52.0 [2.05"] beside the body, at the lower right of the sheet. The width is 52.0, dimensioned. Panduit's product page 'P24B32M - Panduit' prints 52 mm wide and agrees. The sheet PUSP26 (page 3) gives 2.0 in (50.8) for the 0U MID, HALF and FULL forms. That is the family's nominal figure and not this part's width. Weight 9.6 kg is the drawing's.

colour.note: estimated - the title block says MATERIAL/COLOR: N/A, so the body is drawn a dark neutral. THE PLATE, MOULDING, SCREW AND LAMP-WINDOW COLOURS ARE NOT CHECKED against any source. No photograph is held.

ends.note: drawing - the SIDE VIEW is the cord end seen end-on, 52.0 by 112. It prints two Torx screws 6.9 across and a rectangle 19.09 square. They are drawn as decor, on the 2.039 mm to the point of the printed 52.0. The cord part is placed over the rectangle. The stepped outline and the tab above the body are not drawn, as a face is a box. The far end is a plain closed line.

front.note: drawing - the front view. From the cord end: a plate with the maker's wordmark, then the sockets in the order C19, moulding, C19, C19, moulding, C19, C19, moulding, C19. There are six C19 sockets and three mouldings of six C13 sockets. Each moulding is a staggered arrangement of three columns and two rows. The outlet positions are read from the front view and the outlet pitch is not dimensioned. Recounted from the page twice: 6 C19 and 18 C13.

input.note: drawing - 'INPUT PLUG: IEC 60309 3P+E 9H 60A', 'INPUT VOLTAGE: 200-240VAC, DELTA', 'INPUT CURRENT: 60A (48A DERATED)', 'RATED POWER: 17.3kVA'. The title block says the cord is 3m [10'] and the callout says 2921-3302 [115.0'-130.0']; both are stated. A kW figure (note 5) and the kVA figure differ in unit and are not reconciled.

lamps.note: drawing - paired small windows sit beside each outlet: three above and three below each moulding, and two beside each C19. They are drawn as dark decor. No document gives their purpose or colour.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S VECTOR DRAWING. Panduit customer drawing P24B32M_DC rev 01B (08/21/2017) is a vector sheet drawn to no stated scale. It has a front, rear, top (long side) and side (cord) view. Its scale was taken from its own 915.0 overall dimension, which is 449.3 pt, so 2.037 mm to the point. The 622.0 between the buttons agrees at 2.031. Positions were read off renderings at 300 and 400 dpi and off the vector paths. They are good to about 1 mm across and 3 mm along the strip. The library draws the PDU STANDING, cord end down, so a position along the drawing becomes 915 minus that. A position across becomes x. No photograph and no 3D model of the part is held.

mount.note: `rack-side`: the strip stands beside a rack's upright on two mounting buttons, 137.6 from the cord end and 622.0 apart (top view). The drawing says 'VERTICAL, 0U HALF, 2-SIDED' and gives no count of units. `ru: 20` is the whole units the 915 mm length covers (20.6) and is not stated by any document.

outlets.note: drawing - 'OUTLET QTY&TYPE: (18) C13, (6) C19' and the receptacle block, 'IEC 60320/C19 16 A' and 'IEC 60320/C13 10 A'. Each outlet is std/c13-outlet@1 or std/c19-outlet@1. The C19 sockets of the odd banks are unturned. Those of the even banks are turned a half turn, as the lamp windows sit on the outer side. THE DRAWN OUTLET SYMBOLS ARE SMALLER THAN THE REGISTRY'S WELLS, so the drawn centres are an estimate (gaps: outlet-pitch). The outlets are numbered 1 to 24 along the strip from the cord end. THE NUMBERING IS AN ASSUMPTION.

rear.note: drawing - the rear view shows six breaker plates B1 to B6. Each has four crosshair screws, a vertical line legend and a rocker. The earth screw with its symbol is near the cord end. Its head is 12.04 across and carries one slot, 7.95 long and 0.98 wide, that runs along the strip. The slot is drawn as decor under the placed part. That part, common/ground-screw@1, draws a cross cap 5.6 across over it, as the library has no slotted ground screw. The plate is drawn about 58.6 along by 39 across and the part is 70.2 by 46.6 (gaps: breaker-plate-size). The plate's vertical legend and crosshair screws differ from the part (gaps: breaker-plate-design).

sides.note: ESTIMATED from the vector paths of the sheet's TOP VIEW, the view above the front view. It is the library's left face by the same unfold the P42G20M's sheet uses. The face is 112 deep. A 36 mm band holds a field of 101 square dots, and a lower band of 76 mm carries the two buttons. The dots are 0.9 pt, 1.83 mm, on an 8.0 mm pitch, in 4 rows of 26 with three missing in the first row. Counted twice, by bounding box and by distinct centres. Also drawn: four screws 6.5 across, three 6.9 across, and two small marks 5.5 across beside the buttons. The sheet shows no other long side. The right face is built as the documented side, as no document shows this one, without the buttons.
